niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces that are information-rich and clearly structured, with enough visible content to feel complete, but without excessive decorative clutter. They like light or calm visual themes in many contexts, strong and readable hierarchy, concise copy, clear labels, and efficient use of space. They generally prefer practical, task-oriented screens with visible controls and complete sections, though they sometimes want a more focused, minimal modal presentation for alerts.

criteria.description: Prefers screens where all expected sections and settings are populated, with no empty-looking blocks, missing options, or partial content.
Prefers interfaces with clearly separated, labeled sections and a strong top-to-bottom organizational flow.
Prefers layouts that use vertical space efficiently, with tighter spacing and less wasted whitespace.
Prefers seeing more relevant items, settings, or controls on one screen rather than sparse or underfilled layouts.
Prefers direct, intuitive labels and concise explanatory text that make settings and actions immediately understandable.
Prefers a clear title-first hierarchy with obvious focal points and readable emphasis on the main action or section.
Prefers consistent row patterns and obvious control types, such as clear toggles, chevrons, and visible primary actions.
Prefers practical, task-focused screens with fewer distracting decorative elements, less chrome, and simpler composition.
